name: pdk-buildbot-master-failover-fencing
instr:
# Fenced multi-master handover

## Background
We need two Buildbot masters sharing one database to stay available while a host is unresponsive: work and workers should move to the survivor without duplicate results. PB workers currently connect to one master.

## Proposal
Extend the master and worker packages so a surviving master takes over unfinished work and a worker can reconnect to another configured master. PostgreSQL is the shared coordination point; use the `simple` MQ.

## Requirements
- Six independent requests with two masters running and one connected PB worker each produce one successful build when neither master fails; all six requests complete within 35 seconds of submission.
- After the master controlling a running build dies, its worker reconnects to the survivor within 30 seconds, and another master completes the same request successfully within 45 seconds of the kill; the request is completed only once, with one execution on the original master and one on the survivor.
- After the controlling master is frozen, its worker abandons the frozen connection and interrupts its command within 30 seconds, reconnects to the other master and rebuilds the request successfully within 45 seconds of the freeze. When the frozen master resumes after being deactivated, its earlier build remains RETRY; it cannot overwrite the completed request or execute further build steps before rejoining with new ownership. The build step executes once on each master, not again on resumpti
